github_listing.basis: The retained 2026-08-24 host screens and legacy discovery code treat GitHub's web listing as capped around 1,000 results. No primary-source GitHub cap snapshot was retained, so new discovery fails closed near that ceiling and requires date partitions.

github_docs.irrecoverable_step: The enumerated GitHub Community listing and pre-freeze host-screen artifact were not retained. The 328 frozen identifiers and accepted-answer permalinks are reproducible inputs, but population coverage and the exact historical candidate-to-freeze decisions cannot be reconstructed.

prisma.irrecoverable_step: The host screen is retained, but the exact historical post-screen selection procedure, pinned-route index, and redirect state used to choose 213 of 227 exact-host/path rows were not retained.

supabase.irrecoverable_step: The host screen is retained, but the exact historical post-screen selection procedure, pinned-route index, and redirect state used to choose 90 of 132 exact-host/path rows were not retained.

tailwind.irrecoverable_step: The host screen is retained, but the exact historical post-screen selection procedure, pinned-route index, and redirect state used to choose 167 of 202 exact-host/path rows were not retained. One retained project manifest separately records a 91-qrel high-link exclusion, but the other per-row exclusions are not fully recoverable.
